findings.text: `dev/Socket/doc/backoff.md:76` still says Link draws "ONE banner at the top, shown only after 8 s down"; it is now a dot, with the banner only while `urgent()`. Update that sentence (deliverable 5 named only the readme and sheet.md, but this doc now contradicts them).

The task folder holds only requirements.md and the diff: no log, no result of `node public/framework/ux/Dictate/test/reconnect.mjs <base-url>`, and no `reconnect-dot.png`/`reconnect-down.png` screenshots. Deliverable 4 ("it passes") is unproven, and a fresh agent cannot tell what ran. Add the run output and shots to the folder.

Link.js:31 makes the dot 0.45em (about 6 px) on the rail icon; as a press target for "pressing it retries" it is tiny, and on a phone a press will usually hit the AI button and open the sheet instead. Consider a larger invisible hit area.

The `dev-link` to `dev-wire` rename (Link.js:9 onward, the test) is correct: DevBar already uses `.dev-link` for its own buttons (`dev/DevBar/devbar.css:166`, `ask.js:106`), so the old banner class collided. Say so in the readme or commit message so the rename is not mistaken for churn.

`urgent` is wired only for the Servex wire (`ux/Dictate/chat.js:468`); the dev socket reports none, so a dev-socket drop never shows the banner even with a mic live. This matches the ask ("depends on Servex") but is worth one line in `dev/Socket/readme.md`.
